mapper.select: SELECT id, email, code_hash, expires_at, consumed_at, failed_attempts, created_at FROM email_verification_code WHERE email = #{email} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification_code (email, code_hash, expires_at, consumed_at, failed_attempts, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{consumedAt}, #{failedAttempts}, #{createdAt})
